verdict.rationale: Better Stack's docs describe escalation policies that set who is alerted and in what order, continuing until the incident is acknowledged. They give a concrete delayed-escalation example: the on-call person is paged first, and after 3 minutes unacknowledged it escalates to the whole team. Complex rules based on time, team availability and incident origin are also claimed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of repeat rounds or loop-back behavior, detail on configuring multiple step delays and per-step fallback responders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
